news.title: Honey Baisoya finishes week in style with a 65, registers three-shot triumph at DP World Players Championship 2026 to end five-year-long title-drought
Honey Baisoya delivers day’s best 64 to dominate round three and build five-shot lead at DP World Players Championship 2026
Jhared Hack storms into halfway lead at DP World Players Championship 2026
Kshitij Naveed Kaul drives his way to the top in round one of DP World Players Championship 2026
DP World Players Championship to tee-off on February 10 at Qutab Golf Course

gallery.caption: DP World Players Cship 2026: Leading Indian professional Veer Ahlawat tees-off at the Pro-Am event of the DP World Players Championship at the Qutab Golf Course on Sunday
DP World Players Cship 2026: Honey Baisoya's seven-under 63 placed him second on Day 1
DP World Players Cship 2026: Kshitij Naveed Kaul produced a phenomenal eight-under 62 to take the first-round lead
DP World Players Cship 2026: Honey Baisoya posted a 65 in Round 2 to continue in second position
DP World Players Cship 2026: Jhared Hack went bogey-free for the second day in succession and delivered a 63 in Round 2 to storm into the halfway lead
DP World Players Cship 2026: Jamal Hossain's third round of 68 placed him second
DP World Players Cship 2026: Honey Baisoya shot the lowest score of Round 3, a six-under 64, to build an impressive five-shot lead
DP World Players Cship 2026: Veer Ahlawat took third place following his fourth round of 65
DP World Players Cship 2026: Kshitij Naveed Kaul shot a 62 for the second time in the tournament, also the last day’s lowest score, to claim the runner-up spot

DP World Players Cship 2026: Honey Baisoya finished the week in style with a 65 on the final day to register a three-shot triumph and end his five-year-long title-drought; Honey's win also moved him into the lead in the 2026 DP World PGTI Order of Merit
